$comment: Engine settings (ENGINE-PLAN.md §1.2). Caps and prices live here only (DECISIONS.md Q7): never raise a cap without the owner. Prices verified by the owner 17/10/2026 (DECISIONS.md 'E6 readiness: owner decisions'); each entry names its source and date.
$tiersComment: tiers.*.forcedToolChoice (OWNER D3, finding 17/10/2026, claude-api skill): forced tool_choice (any / tool) returns a 400 on Claude Sonnet 5.5 (also Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1) whatever the thinking setting: a model restriction, not a thinking one. Claude Haiku 5.5 accepts it, with thinking on or off. So cheap (Haiku) forces the nudge's tool call and strong (Sonnet) sends auto with the instruction in the message.

thinking.$comment: OWNER D2 17/10/2026 (DECISIONS.md 'E6 step c0'): each agent's config/agents/<key>.json says thinking "off" or "default"; "off" for every agent in the first full live run, to be turned on per agent later. "off" is sent as the request's thinking field from `off` below, per model (claude-api skill, read 17/10/2026): Claude Haiku 5.5 accepts {type: disabled} at effort low, medium or high; Claude Sonnet 5.5 returns a 400 for {type: disabled}, and its lowest setting is {type: between_tools} (no extended thinking; effort high or below; no other field in thinking). "default" sends no thinking field (the model's default: adaptive). A model with no entry here refuses an "off" agent before any call.

vision.$comment: E6 c0: image_analyze is priced as vision tokens on the Anthropic text model (owner row 20). Per the vision docs (read 17/10/2026): an image costs ceil(width/28) x ceil(height/28) visual tokens; an image over the model's long-edge or visual-token limit is downscaled first (aspect kept), which caps the cost. Claude 4.7 and later models (Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5) are in the high-resolution tier: 2576 px long edge, 4784 visual tokens. The reservation uses the image's own pixel size (lib/vision.mjs); the settle is the response's usage.

image.$comment: Only openai/gpt-5-image-mini may run (owner 17/10/2026). The opaque model stays disabled by the owner's decision (opaqueModelApproved false), so opaque images are refused. E6 c0: the live client is providers/openrouter.mjs (OpenRouter chat completions with modalities image+text, the legacy route); timeoutMs is per HTTP attempt; retries and backoff are live.retries/backoffMs/backoffMaxMs (approved defaults), every attempt reserved again. maxImageBytes refuses a larger returned image. Engine settings, not caps.
image.generationEndpointNote: E6 wrap-up (18/10/2026): OpenRouter's record of one generation (GET ?id=gen-..., docs read 18/10/2026), read by npm run settle:images to settle estimated image rows; no image and no model call

upscale.$comment: OWNER DECISION 17/10/2026: local Real-ESRGAN may run as a child process (src/engine/lib/esrgan.mjs only): this pinned copy, no network, inside the job jail, killed by the E-STOP. Copied from the legacy station's download (realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan v0.2.5.0 build 20220424, model realesrgan-x4plus; github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN releases) and sha256-identical to it. Licences in ASSETS.md. tools/ is git-ignored: the binary is never committed. Method, model, scale and alpha method come from station.config.json upscale (they are part of the build key).

anthropic.$comment: USD per million tokens. cacheWritePerM is the 5-minute cache write. longPrompt: a request whose prompt (input + cache writes + cache reads) is over overTokens pays those prices for the whole request, output included (guard.mjs priceTier).

anthropic-web.$comment: Anthropic server-side web tools (Q6): web search USD 0.01 per search plus tokens, web fetch tokens only. perCall is the per-call fee; the tokens are priced at the text model's rates on the Anthropic call that carries the results.

openai/gpt-5-image-mini.source: owner, 17/10/2026: token-priced on OpenRouter, so perImage is the guard's reservation; each call settles to the cost OpenRouter reports for it, marked estimated if none is reported (tools/index.mjs image_generate)

*.source: mock provider: no model is called

caps.$comment: Owner, 17/10/2026 (Q2): USD 5.00 per job (images included), USD 10.00 per day, USD 10.00 per line per day, USD 0.50 per scout run (a genre-scout run is one research job: perJobUsdByLine). perRunUsd (one agent run): USD 2.00, owner-approved 17/10/2026 (owner spend rule; was 1.00, carried over from the StarNet era; DECISIONS.md 'E6 step c0: owner decisions, part 2'). Outer limits the owner sets outside the engine: the Anthropic Console monthly workspace limit and the OpenRouter key limit of USD 2 a day. per-agent 0 = off, 12 hops. imagesPerDay 0 = no count cap (image spend still counts in every USD cap).

live.$comment: E6 a0: the live Anthropic text provider (providers/anthropic.mjs). timeoutMs is per HTTP attempt. retries: further attempts after a 429, a 5xx or a network error, each reserved again through the guard; 400/401/403 are never retried. Wait between attempts: backoffMs x 2^attempt, capped at backoffMaxMs (a server retry-after is used when given, within the cap). Not caps: engine settings, approved by the owner as set 17/10/2026 (DECISIONS.md 'E6 step a0 build record').

web.$comment: E6 b0: the live web backend (providers/anthropic-web.mjs). Each web_search / web_fetch tool call is ONE Anthropic request on `model` with ONE server tool: the basic, directly called versions in `tools` (per the claude-api reference and platform docs 17/10/2026; the dynamic-filtering versions run code execution, one more tool, and are not used). max_uses per request = maxUsesPerRequest, lowered to the run's remaining web calls; the run's web-call cap (agent maxWebCalls) is counted across requests. Reservation: max_uses x the per-call fee (pricing.anthropic-web) + the prompt estimate and resultTokensPerUse x max_uses at the model's dearest input price + maxTokens output. Settle: web_search_requests x 0.01 + the response's tokens at the model's prices. fetchMaxContentTokens caps a fetched page. No domain allow/block list: none is set (owner). effort: the relay's output_config.effort. Engine settings, not caps (set 17/10/2026, for the owner's approval).

webSources.$comment: OWNER DECISION 17/10/2026 (DECISIONS.md 'E6 readiness' item 1 and 'E6 step b0: owner decisions'): v1 scout sources are trend articles, editorial roundups and community discussion found by web search. Store chart, browse and streaming pages are out: Steam, itch.io, Twitch, YouTube, written as bare domains (the API includes subdomains, e.g. store.steampowered.com, any itch.io page, www.twitch.tv, m.youtube.com, and rejects wildcards such as '*.itch.io'). Sent as blocked_domains on BOTH web_search and web_fetch for every agent with web tools (one shared relay), and the engine refuses a web_fetch to these hosts before anything is reserved or sent (lib/web-sources.mjs). Add nothing without the owner. Twitch and YouTube data come later through their official APIs only.
webSources.$fetchComment: OWNER DECISION D1, 17/10/2026 (DECISIONS.md 'E6 step b2: owner decisions'): agents never fetch etsy.com pages (Etsy's terms restrict automated reads). The engine refuses a web_fetch to these hosts or any subdomain before anything is reserved or sent, like blockedDomains, but they are NOT sent to the API as blocked_domains, so etsy.com results still come back from web_search (titles, prices and keywords as shown in the results). Until the Etsy Open API is in place (owner applying; terms check first) genre-scout demand evidence is 'indicative' and the competitor count 'not measured'.

runtime.$maxRunningJobsComment: L2 (19/10/2026): at most this many jobs run at once on a Station instance started by npm start (live and dev), across every line; a further start waits in the queue as "next" and starts when a running job ends. Demo, dry runs and the line scripts are not limited by it (one job per line still applies everywhere). An engine setting, not a cap.
runtime.$confirmComment: L2: every page action that can spend needs a confirm token from POST /api/spend/quote (single use, bound to the action and its parameters, valid confirmTtlMs).

outerLimits.$comment: L2: limits the owner sets OUTSIDE the engine, shown in the spend confirmation only; never caps (the engine's caps are under caps). anthropicConsoleMonthlyUsd: the Anthropic Console's monthly workspace limit in USD, null = not configured (the dialog then says so); the remaining figure is that limit less this Dublin month's Anthropic rows in the station ledger (other use of the workspace is not seen). openrouterDailyUsd: the OpenRouter key limit (owner, 17/10/2026).
